items.text: In October, World Series games were broadcast on television for the first time, and the New York Yankees beat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 3.
items.question: Where did you see or hear the Yankees and Dodgers World Series that fall, and whose television or radio was it?
items.source_quote: October 6 – World Series games are broadcast on television for the first time. The New York Yankees defeat the Brooklyn Dodgers, 4 games to 3, to win their 11th World Series Title.

items.text: On October 14, Air Force test pilot Captain Chuck Yeager flew the Bell X-1 rocket plane faster than the speed of sound.
